youtube_metadata.title: The House of Wisdom: Baghdad's Lost Golden Age of Science
youtube_metadata.description:
Long before the European Renaissance, an intellectual revolution unfolded in 9th-century Baghdad that laid the groundwork for modern mathematics, physics, and astronomy.

In this documentary, we explore the legendary House of Wisdom (Bayt al-Hikma), where scholars like Al-Khwarizmi developed algebra and algorithms, Ibn al-Haytham founded empirical optics, and master astronomers mapped the celestial coordinates using precision astrolabes.

CHAPTERS:
00:00 - Prologue: The 9th-Century Intellectual Explosion
00:12 - Bayt al-Hikma: Al-Khwarizmi and the Birth of Algebra
00:24 - Ibn al-Haytham: Revolutionizing Physics and Optics
00:35 - Mapping the Cosmos: The Precision Astrolabe
00:43 - The Golden Legacy
